evidence: Static inspection of frozen task .qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r1/task. (1) task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile (both sha256 0a75419e9598ded9317b26bbf0d2b12de0b9b11185fb4c9fed1ca7f3e52467d1). Its only COPY lines are 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/' and 'COPY assets/ /assets/'; /app is created by 'mkdir -p /app', git-initialised and holds only '.gitkeep' committed as 'Initialize task workspace'. No COPY of solution/ or tests/; [verifier].environment_mode = "separate" (task.toml:28). (2) The build context environment/ contains exactly three files: instructions/hireops_rules.md (11027 B), instructions/integration.md (1090 B), assets/seed_data.json (28549 B). No starter, skeleton, schema/DDL, package.json or partial UI. (3) hireops_rules.md is behavioural requirements in requester voice; line 3-5 says 'Routes, field names, element ids, button labels and the shape of the pages are up to you'. It names status codes 401/403/404/409 as behaviour, not a route list. integration.md names only the runtime contract (/app/server.js, port 3000, GET /api/health, DB_PATH), which is the public contract also in instruction.md:15; it differs from the template copy only by an added 5-line symlink/delivery paragraph (no answer content). (4) seed_data.json holds inputs only: keys generated_note, stages, candidate_status_labels, thread_page_size, users(id,name,email,role), jobs, applications(incl. position, stage, reject_reason, rejected_from), messages(127), notes(3), reads(read_count). No precomputed derived outputs (no unread counts, seen flags, versions, activity lines, expected figures). Candidate wording/page size are inputs that the notes explicitly direct the builder to read. (5) Rubric non-reproduction measured: for all 56 criteria parsed with tomllib from tests/*/*/judge.toml, zero 8-word verbatim n-gram overlaps with hireops_rules.md+integration.md; zero 10-word overlaps between instructions+seed and tests/app_context.md and all five prompt.md files. grep for probe|sentinel|GATE|criteri|rubric|judge under environment/ found nothing (only ordinary words 'answers'). Lessons file check (handoffs/LESSONS_FROM_COLDERWATER_2026-10-08.md): lesson 12 (notes mirroring criteria) bears most closely; the notes paraphrase requirements the criteria grade, which lessons 1/row 6 require be public, but they reproduce no criterion text verbatim, so it is not an answer leak for row 16 (checklist voice is row 1's concern). Lessons 13-16 (public URLs, timing, restart, double grading) do not bear on the agent image. Counterexample attempts: a weak builder cannot copy a finished app because none exists in /app, /instructions or /assets; a conforming alternative is not penalised by anything in the environment since it imposes no routes/ids. Limits: the agent image was not built in this review (no Docker allowed); contents are determined by the Dockerfile and a non-digest-pinned public base image node:22-bookworm-slim plus pinned npm globals express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1, none of which can contain this task's deliverable. Workbook rows 16 (Quality Checks and Internal Quality Checks sheets) carry no additional annotation beyond the check text.
